collectible.title: Schezo's Staff
collectible.subtitle: An old staff he used during his magic school days.
collectible.text: A silver staff Schezo once used back when he was in magic school. He has no use for it now that he has the Dark Sword, so he handed it off to you.

collectible.title: Schezo's Boxers
collectible.subtitle: Supposedly the Boxers of Darkness.
collectible.text: Schezo's boxers, in the same blue as his bandana. You didn't steal them from him, did you?
collectible.unlock: Have Schezo lose before Arle does. (Winning is not required.)

collectible.title: Tenori Zoh Plushie
collectible.subtitle: Fits right on your palmtop!
collectible.text: A plush in the likeness of Schezo's pet and partner. Who knew Schezo was a bit of a softie? Hang on, the camera seems to have a picture sticking out of it...
collectible.unlock: Defeat Schezo in a sudden death showdown.
